summary: CCEP filed a 6-K to provide context for certain resolutions at its 28 May 2026 Annual General Meeting, specifically Resolution 25 (waiver of mandatory offer under Takeover Code Rule 9) and director re-elections. The filing clarifies that a share repurchase cannot occur without shareholder approval of the Rule 9 waiver, which addresses shareholding trigger thresholds for major holder Olive (37.2% stake). The board recommends a FOR vote on all resolutions. This is a routine shareholder communication supplementing meeting materials, not a special situation. No deal, activist campaign, strategic review, or tender is involved.
